name: BACH_0314
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Flagged Tier 2 for a singleton Invasive conformal set [F1] with ER/PR/HER2/Ki-67 stains drafted; verify invasion directly.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Strong call; dataset ECE 5% |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (alpha = 0.10, 90% coverage) | Single class; 90% dataset coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 88th OOD percentile, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Passes QC; moderately high OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree (true) | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Invasive (80%); 1/5 InSitu [F5] | Mostly invasive; close InSitu neighbor |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Scarce score (+0.51) [F2], but 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 2) · context · Below-typical score (+0.49) [F3]; 8/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 3, 8, 10) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.24) [F4], 3/20 spot check; 0 dead cells counted · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.21); strongest validated concept (20/20 spot check) · Validated
- **Nuclear size and variation** (regions 0, 3, 4) · context · Mean 75 µm² (93rd percentile) [F7]; CV 0.58 (90th percentile) [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops P(invasive) beyond random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unvalidated (+0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- InSitu carcinoma mimics invasion; close neighbor BACH_0155 (83% similarity) is InSitu, differing in duct confinement and pleomorphism.
- Moderate out-of-distribution shift (88th percentile) misleads the classifier despite 90% dataset-level conformal coverage.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 3, 4, 5, 8**: Highest risk (86%–98%); confirm stromal invasion (region 8) before signing ER/PR/HER2/Ki-67 orders.
2. **Regions 2, 10**: Check duct confinement (region 2) and nuclear pleomorphism (region 10) to exclude InSitu.
3. **Regions 3, 8, 10, 11**: Inspect directly; disregard unreliable necrosis, mitosis, and normal-lobule concept scores.
